description: baseline: LightGBM binary classifier with 5-fold stratified CV (OOF AUC) — chosen because N=891 is small (< 10k), gradient boosting dominates at this scale, and 5-fold CV is more reliable than a single 80/20 split for such small N

Added Titanic-specific feature engineering (Title, FamilySize, HasCabin, Deck, FarePerPerson, interactions) and Optuna hyperparameter tuning with 200 trials/5-fold CV to push LightGBM well beyond baseline 0.867
